title: campanula cervicaria var. lingulata
intro: Campanula cervicaria var. lingulata, commonly known as Bellflower, is a flowering plant species within the Campanula genus, known for its bell-shaped flowers. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is said to have various health benefits, including the ability to treat respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds, due to its expectorant properties.
